entries.274dca3d0cc162b1: This is a method of washing and finishing products made of materials that cannot be used with water, such as wool, silk and some synthetic fibers, by washing them in a petroleum-based solvent mixed with ozone. It applies to items such as suits, skirts and sweaters. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥3,849 million.
entries.5243cbde1229821a: This is a method of washing and finishing products made of materials such as cotton, linen and some synthetic fibers, by dissolving detergent and other agents in warm water and washing in a washing machine. It applies to items such as dress shirts. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,250 million.
entries.72c598f20e933d6c: These are sales of promotional goods to agency offices and others, and annual fees for Special Members (a system under which general customers join by paying an annual fee at an office). Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥144 million.
entries.b75517435776c638: This is a single segment in home cleaning. Garments accepted at stores are washed and finished at its own factories and then returned. Stores come in three formats: general stores, Pelicans and Coins, and as of February 28, 2026, the number of stores was 478 (147 directly operated stores, 271 quasi-directly operated stores, and 60 agency stores). Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥5,244 million.
entries.ce0b631aae48518c: A company based in Fukuoka Prefecture that provides home dry cleaning of clothing at 478 stores, comprising directly operated, quasi-directly operated, and agency stores.
